description.en: Sets the player's friendship points, or adds to them when the second argument is true. Friendship points are a value kept with the party data (0 to 9,999,999). In add mode the result is kept between 0 and 9,999,999; a plain set stores the value as given.
New value, or amount to add.
true to add instead of set.

true.
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: A reward after a tutorial (real usage, from ev42021600.nut)
